inputs.ref: DRIEW listing (corpus MAP08): 'vegetable-tanned full-grain pig leather, 1mm thickness'

inputs.name: shell stiffness E
inputs.ref: placeholder: the tensile value measured for 1.2 mm CALFskin (Mihai et al., Materials 2022, 15(15):5107); this is pig leather and has not been tested

inputs.name: cards
inputs.ref: contents not stated; the depth was measured flat

inputs.name: closed thickness at the spine
inputs.ref: DRIEW listing: Measurements (Flat) Depth 1.8 cm, 'measured by hand, laid flat'; length 14.5 cm, width 9.5 cm

inputs.name: bill-pocket gusset crease (one of two): stack it wraps
inputs.ref: the V pleat at each side of the bill pocket, collapsed flat when the pocket is empty; the void is assumed to look like the One Piece loops (about one leather thickness). Two such creases, identical here

inputs.name: main fold: stack it wraps (derived from the closed thickness)
inputs.ref: derived: closed thickness 18 mm - 2 x 1 mm of shell; the lower bound 10 mm is assumed (the pack compresses). the wallet folds once; this fold wraps everything but the outer shell

inputs.name: closed thickness
inputs.ref: DRIEW listing: Measurements (Flat) Depth 1.8 cm, 'measured by hand, laid flat'; length 14.5 cm, width 9.5 cm

sweeps.note: R/t = 0.25 < 0.5: closed form only; the elastic model cannot say whether the leather survives

failure_modes.name: Grain crack at the hinge
failure_modes.text: bill-pocket gusset crease (one of two): tension-face strain 18.9 % loose to 20.6 % taut (closed-form limit 50.0 %), inside radius 0.50 mm, R/t = 0.5; the model's leather bridges this stack, so the closed form is the number to read; inside radius below 1 x t: the grain relies on the finish to hold, expect cracking (R/t=0.50); outer-fibre strain >= 20 % (screening threshold, not a validated failure criterion). Cycles to crack need flex-test data.

failure_modes.name: Permanent set
failure_modes.text: needs a cyclic viscoplastic model and fold-and-measure data; it is the usual first visible sign of a worn hinge

failure_modes.name: Finish crazing or delamination
failure_modes.text: a film-on-substrate model quoted in prior-research/reference/durability.md section 2b has a stiff finish buckling at 2-12 % compressive strain; at bill-pocket gusset crease (one of two) the compression face is -17.7 % and the grain is in tension, not compression

failure_modes.name: Stress at stitch holes
failure_modes.text: the wallet is stitched, but whether the stitching crosses or pins a fold is not recorded

failure_modes.name: Skive-line or thickness step
failure_modes.text: whether the folds are skived is not recorded; a skive line is a stiffness step where cracks start

failure_modes.name: Edge paint chipping
failure_modes.text: the edge treatment is not recorded; record it (painted edges chip where they flex)

failure_modes.name: Pocket-mouth and corner abrasion
failure_modes.text: 3 pocket(s) recorded; needs the card-pull scenario (roadmap phase 4) and wear photos to calibrate

failure_modes.name: Perforation tear line
failure_modes.text: no recorded row of holes crosses a fold

failure_modes.name: Layer delamination
failure_modes.text: layers are treated as perfectly bonded; the record does not say what is glued

failure_modes.name: Cold embrittlement
failure_modes.text: needs a cold flex test; no built-in factor

failure_modes.name: Over-drying
failure_modes.text: needs a measured material state (stiffness and strain to crack at a stated humidity)

failure_modes.name: Long-term chemical ageing
failure_modes.text: ageing enters only through measured aged states; none recorded
